answer: Each agent must lock a refundable bond before its first bid, and that bond unlocks only after a season of peer-attested work. A nebula of throwaway accounts cannot share one deposit: every extra identity posts its own capital, slashed if two keys sign mutually exclusive jobs. Settlement follows a public river of countersigned receipts, so cloned histories fail a simple replay check. At the zenith of an epoch, a disjoint jury samples interaction graphs and evicts clusters whose edge overlap exceeds a threshold, so mass-created sockpuppets never reach voting weight.
